warning: The descriptions below are functional summaries of user-reported mode behaviour, not verbatim official OOC prologues. Do not present them as original text.

scenarios.name: Enrollment
scenarios.purpose: Start as a newly enrolled academy student.
reported_behaviour: Strongly anchors the protagonist to student life.
Naturally leads toward classes, department affiliation, campus relationships and evaluations.
scenarios.recommended_for: A school-life campaign with academy progression at the centre.
scenarios.ai_initialization: Establish the protagonist as a new student, then present a concrete first choice or immediate situation without deciding the protagonist's actions.

scenarios.name: Free Mode
scenarios.purpose: Start in the wider Lumencia setting with greater freedom to define the protagonist's status and starting location.
reported_behaviour: Less strongly tied to the student role.
Can support an outsider, noble, adventurer, adult, political agent or custom background.
The academy may still become relevant depending on the campaign.
scenarios.recommended_for: A custom protagonist or a campaign that may range beyond the academy.
scenarios.ai_initialization: Ask no unnecessary setup questions if the player has already provided a profile. Use their chosen role and location; otherwise open with an actionable scene that leaves role and intent under player control.

scenarios.name: Character Preview
scenarios.purpose: A start option reported to expose or foreground parts of the cast, including characters who may appear less often in ordinary academy play.
reported_behaviour: May function as a character introduction mode.
Some players report continuing into an actual story from it; do not assume it is purely a gallery.
scenarios.recommended_for: Cast discovery, character-focused play or testing a chosen character setup.
scenarios.ai_initialization: Introduce the selected characters in an observable scene, but do not assume the protagonist already knows their private histories.
